title: GPT-6 Astra leads on math benchmarks, but not on software engineering
justification: Primary-source Epoch AI data insight reporting a domain breakdown of the Epoch Capabilities Index for GPT-6 Astra against Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6 Sol and Kimi K3. It passes the system-card test: it reports quantitative capability measurements with uncertainty - general ECI (157.63-166.31), Math-ECI (158.39-169.83) and Software Engineering ECI (160.47-167.44), each with 90% confidence intervals - and concludes Astra leads on math while not leading on software engineering. This is the same document class already catalogued for this publisher, e.g. epoch-ai-claude-ds-eci at epoch.ai/data-insights/claude-ds-eci and epoch-ai-gpt-5-5-independent-eval at epoch.ai/data-insights/codex-engineer-effort, and it is a distinct evaluation of a model generation not previously covered by an Epoch ECI breakdown.
notes: Capability benchmarking only - no safety or dangerous-capability evaluations, hence no risk_domains tags, consistent with the epoch-ai-claude-ds-eci row. Openness recorded as closed: the most restricted model covered is a closed public-API model (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6 Sol); Kimi K3 is open-weight. Epoch notes ECI scores are refit whenever results are added, so values may be revised over time.
